name: @hasna/draw
description: Headless board SDK for quick notes and freehand drawings, like Google Keep. A framework agnostic board and card model with a portable Excalidraw compatible drawing scene, JSON import and export, plus optional React board, card, and draw surface components

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:lib && bun run build:react && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --external nanoid
scripts.build:react: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/react/index.ts --outdir dist/react --target browser --external react --external react-dom --external 'react/jsx-runtime' --external 'react/jsx-dev-runtime' --external nanoid
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --external commander --external chalk --external nanoid
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan:artifact

author: hasna
